passes.reasoning: G01 compares the learned greedy arm with the fixed and recalibrated agreement thresholds at matched budgets. Neither baseline has free labels. Greedy minus fixed is -23.2, -8.8, 0.0 and -0.1 pp at 5%, 10%, 25% and 50%, so the result never favors the learned arm. L7a, at equal labels, is also negative (-2.06 and -3.35 pp). The confound is controlled, so W2 is false. For claim 3, only E01 reports embedding AUC gain (-0.001) and neighbor ratio (about 1.0). All later pools use the same model, task and proxy as E01, so the kill rule is not met. No entry shows a gain of 0.05 or a ratio of 1.5, so claim 3 stays open and W3 is false.

G01 compares the learned greedy allocator with the fixed agreement threshold and the recal threshold at identical call budgets. Neither baseline has free labels. Recal sees only the verified-label stream greedy sees. Greedy minus fixed is -23.2 pp at 5% and -8.8 pp at 10%, and ties at 25% and 50%. Seed sd is under 1 pp except at 5%, so the difference never favors the learned arm. That is a controlled comparison, so claim 2 is not_supported and W2 is false. Claim 3: embedding AUC and neighbor ratio were measured only in E01. Later entries reuse the same GSM8K/Qwen pools and report no embedding statistics, so there is no qualifying non-E01 kill or support. Claim 3 stays open, and W3 is false.

G01 compares the learned greedy allocator with a label-free fixed agreement threshold and a recal threshold at the same call budgets. The baselines get no free labels. Greedy trails fixed by -23.2 pp at 5% and -8.8 pp at 10%, and ties it at 25% and 50%. L7a repeats the test at equal labels and greedy loses by 2 to 3 pp. That is not_supported, and the free-label confound has been controlled, so W2 is false. For claim 3, E01 is the only entry with embedding statistics (AUC gain -0.001, neighbor ratio about 1.0). Every later entry uses the same model, task and proxy and reports no embedding AUC or neighbor ratio. The kill condition therefore isn't met, and claim 3 is open. The ledger holds claim 3 as not_supported, so W3 is false.
